title: Converting to Negative Exponents
text:
Remember these conversions:

- $\frac{1}{x^n} = x^{-n}$
- $\sqrt{x} = x^{\frac{1}{2}}$
- $\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = x^{-\frac{1}{2}}$

title: Convert Each Term
text:
Convert term by term:

- $\frac{3}{x^2} = 3x^{-2}$
- $\frac{4}{\sqrt{x}} = \frac{4}{x^{1/2}} = 4x^{-1/2}$
- $2x$ stays as $2x$

title: Rewritten Form
text:
The rewritten function is:

$y = 3x^{-2} - 4x^{-1/2} + 2x$

Now you can apply the power rule to each term.
